scope: Section 09: Lock, unlock, Logout, Stop task and Stop host remain distinct actions

lock_contract.managed_session: Lock denies ordinary HTTP/WSS/RTC authority. Unlock verifies the same current canonical principal, retains SID/device scope grant/absolute expiry, rotates refresh/CSRF and increments access generation. Pre-lock access never revives.
lock_contract.background_execution: Existing explicit execution grants can survive a lock through a server-only execution lookup. Revocation, expiry and current role/project/device limits still apply. Lock does not itself cancel enrolled tasks; browser/computer/process actions remain constrained by privacy and observation authority.
lock_contract.privacy: Matching device browser and capture grants become private/revoked before lock. Unlock never silently clears these private barriers or resumes a previous handoff. Ordinary lock/revoke closes exact principal/SID RTC peers; entering a global private observation barrier closes all host RTC transports before acknowledgement.
lock_contract.transport_failure: A failed peer shutdown retains privacy, still locks the canonical SID and reports503 without claiming observation closure. Reauthentication remains possible.
lock_contract.native: OS keyring refresh survives423. Native unlock verifies and rotates inside the trusted same-host Rust bridge. OIDC transmits only its one-use browser binding to WebView; refresh is never returned to JavaScript. All native windows receive lock/unlock events.
lock_contract.http_status: A current locked JWT gets423 on canonical and protected HTTP. Cookie mutations enforce exact-origin CSRF before returning423. Revoked/expired managed JWTs get401; resource-denied live sessions retain403. Binary transfers signal the same local Lock overlay.

host_stop_contract.request: Current host administrator + exact host_id + acknowledge:true. Cookie transport requires same-origin CSRF; remote authentication retains TLS.
host_stop_contract.effects: Graceful local service teardown disconnects clients and observation, stops local tasks/terminals, pauses schedules until restart and requests reachable cloud-task cancellation without destroying dedicated machines.
host_stop_contract.final_authority: Current SID/host-admin are rechecked before shutdown. An aborted queued request notifies native pending-intent cancellation. Accepted desktop shutdown uses private child stdout plus intentional exit79; native automatic restart is suppressed. Explicit Restart Backend remains a separate user action.
